# core/ascii.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/ascii.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

ASCII character classes and case conversion. Bytes at
128 and above are never changed or classified, so UTF-8 text passes
through untouched.

What is proved: each classifier returns exactly the range test its spec fn
names, and the case conversions change exactly the letters of the other
case and nothing else, byte for byte, keeping the length.

`import "core/ascii.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`ascii_is_upper`](#ascii_is_upper) | `c` is `A`..`Z`. |
| [`ascii_is_lower`](#ascii_is_lower) | `c` is `a`..`z`. |
| [`ascii_is_alpha`](#ascii_is_alpha) | `c` is a letter. |
| [`ascii_is_alnum`](#ascii_is_alnum) | `c` is a letter or a decimal digit. |
| [`ascii_to_lower`](#ascii_to_lower) | `c` in lower case if it is a capital letter, else `c`. |
| [`ascii_to_upper`](#ascii_to_upper) | `c` in upper case if it is a small letter, else `c`. |
| [`bytes_to_lower`](#bytes_to_lower) | A copy of `b` with every capital letter made small. |
| [`bytes_to_upper`](#bytes_to_upper) | A copy of `b` with every small letter made a capital. |
| [`bytes_eq_nocase`](#bytes_eq_nocase) | `a` and `b` are the same length and equal apart from the case of letters (header names, command names, file extensions). |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `ascii_is_upper`

```bastio
fn ascii_is_upper(c: u8) -> bool
  ensures result == ascii_upper_spec(c)
```

`c` is `A`..`Z`.

Example:

```bastio
if !ascii_is_upper(65) || ascii_is_upper(97) || ascii_is_upper(64) { return 1; }
```

### `ascii_is_lower`

```bastio
fn ascii_is_lower(c: u8) -> bool
  ensures result == ascii_lower_spec(c)
```

`c` is `a`..`z`.

Example:

```bastio
if !ascii_is_lower(122) || ascii_is_lower(65) || ascii_is_lower(123) { return 1; }
```

### `ascii_is_alpha`

```bastio
fn ascii_is_alpha(c: u8) -> bool
  ensures result == (ascii_upper_spec(c) || ascii_lower_spec(c))
```

`c` is a letter.

Example:

```bastio
if !ascii_is_alpha(90) || !ascii_is_alpha(97) || ascii_is_alpha(48) || ascii_is_alpha(233) { return 1; }
```

### `ascii_is_alnum`

```bastio
fn ascii_is_alnum(c: u8) -> bool
  ensures result == (ascii_upper_spec(c) || ascii_lower_spec(c) || (48 <= c && c <= 57))
```

`c` is a letter or a decimal digit.

Example:

```bastio
if !ascii_is_alnum(48) || !ascii_is_alnum(65) || ascii_is_alnum(95) || ascii_is_alnum(32) { return 1; }
```

### `ascii_to_lower`

```bastio
fn ascii_to_lower(c: u8) -> u8
  ensures ascii_upper_spec(c) ==> result == c + 32
  ensures !ascii_upper_spec(c) ==> result == c
```

`c` in lower case if it is a capital letter, else `c`.

Example:

```bastio
let a = ascii_to_lower(72);   // 'H'
let b = ascii_to_lower(104);  // 'h'
let c = ascii_to_lower(49);   // '1'
assert a == 104 && b == 104 && c == 49;
```

### `ascii_to_upper`

```bastio
fn ascii_to_upper(c: u8) -> u8
  ensures ascii_lower_spec(c) ==> result == c - 32
  ensures !ascii_lower_spec(c) ==> result == c
```

`c` in upper case if it is a small letter, else `c`.

Example:

```bastio
let a = ascii_to_upper(104);  // 'h'
let c = ascii_to_upper(49);   // '1'
assert a == 72 && c == 49;
```

### `bytes_to_lower`

```bastio
fn bytes_to_lower(b: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == blen(b)
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < blen(b) ==> (ascii_upper_spec(bget(b, k)) ==> bget(result, k) == bget(b, k) + 32)
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < blen(b) ==> (!ascii_upper_spec(bget(b, k)) ==> bget(result, k) == bget(b, k))
```

A copy of `b` with every capital letter made small.

Example:

```bastio
let b = bfrom("Content-Type: Text/HTML");
let l = bytes_to_lower(b);
assert blen(l) == blen(b);
let ok = bytes_eq_str(l, "content-type: text/html");
bfree(l);
bfree(b);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `bytes_to_upper`

```bastio
fn bytes_to_upper(b: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == blen(b)
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < blen(b) ==> (ascii_lower_spec(bget(b, k)) ==> bget(result, k) == bget(b, k) - 32)
  ensures forall k: u64 :: k < blen(b) ==> (!ascii_lower_spec(bget(b, k)) ==> bget(result, k) == bget(b, k))
```

A copy of `b` with every small letter made a capital.

Example:

```bastio
let b = bfrom("Mixed Case 42");
let u = bytes_to_upper(b);
let ok = bytes_eq_str(u, "MIXED CASE 42");
bfree(u);
bfree(b);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `bytes_eq_nocase`

```bastio
fn bytes_eq_nocase(a: &Bytes, b: &Bytes) -> bool
  ensures result ==> blen(a) == blen(b) && (forall k: u64 :: k < blen(a) ==> ascii_fold_eq(bget(a, k), bget(b, k)))
```

`a` and `b` are the same length and equal apart from the case of letters
(header names, command names, file extensions).

Example:

```bastio
let a = bfrom("Content-Length");
let b = bfrom("content-LENGTH");
let c = bfrom("content-width");
let same = bytes_eq_nocase(a, b);
let differ = bytes_eq_nocase(a, c);
bfree(a);
bfree(b);
bfree(c);
if !same || differ { return 1; }
```

## Specification functions

### `ascii_upper_spec`

```bastio
spec fn ascii_upper_spec(c: u8) -> bool {
  65 <= c && c <= 90
}
```

`c` is `A`..`Z`.

### `ascii_lower_spec`

```bastio
spec fn ascii_lower_spec(c: u8) -> bool {
  97 <= c && c <= 122
}
```

`c` is `a`..`z`.

### `ascii_fold_eq`

```bastio
spec fn ascii_fold_eq(x: u8, y: u8) -> bool {
  x == y || (ascii_upper_spec(x) && y == x + 32) || (ascii_upper_spec(y) && x == y + 32)
}
```

`x` and `y` are the same letter in the same or a different case, or the
same byte.
